question: What stairway of powers is always established in the state of Rudra-union?
premises: A stairway-garland of powers is always established in the state of Rudra-union.
That stairway extends through consciousness, breath, quality, and body.
This structure is presented as permanently established.
inference: Therefore in the state of Rudra-union there is an ever-established stairway of powers spanning consciousness, breath, quality, and body.
plain_english: By the state of Rudra-union, that stairway-garland of powers—ending in consciousness, breath, quality, and body—is always indeed established.
